name: a-dry-run-publishes-nothing
rule: `dryRun` reports the intended effect and makes no write request whatsoever.
why: A reply is public the moment it exists and deleting it does not unpublish what people already saw, so the dry run is the only safe way to confirm a target. It is also checked AFTER the pageId guard, so a dry run can never report that a call would work when it could not.
